chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that a جنازة be followed with a censer.

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْإِسْنَادِ: the chain of transmission of the hadith
key_terms.بِمِجْمَرَةٍ: with a censer used for burning incense
key_terms.جَنَازَةٌ: a funeral bier or funeral procession

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to accompany a funeral procession with incense or a censer in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prohibited accompanying a funeral bier with a censer. It relates to the jurisprudence and etiquette of funerals and indicates a restriction concerning practices performed during the procession of the deceased.
